title: Countries calling for a deep-sea mining pause or ban (count)

source.name: Momentum for a Moratorium -- government positions tracker

notes: The DSCC's public tracker of governments backing a moratorium, precautionary pause, or ban on deep-sea mining counted 24 countries in 2024, growing to 37 by mid-2025 (including additions announced around the June 2025 UN Ocean Conference) -- even as the ISA had still not finished its exploitation regulations.
